Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
"jeroen rombouts" <jeroen....@pandora.be> writes:

> Is having a IC title clan specific?

No, but it is sect specific.

Of all the titles, only the Justicar titles are clan specific.

> What I mean is if, for example, Arika
> Clan Impersonates like a Brujah, is she still an IC member?

Yes.

(In V:tM, this wouldn't be the case. It's fine in V:TES, however.)
